programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them. For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc. Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from "The Avengers"!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: A lone cow has gone wild and escaped into a neighbouring field.Dr. Matt has been called in to lend a hand. The heifer " went wild" two months ago and various tactics are employed to get Matt close enough to get a good shot with his dart gun. But the wary cow wins the first round and escapes. Matt decides to return another day.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Chief Inspector Cathy Hyde is on a warrant to access a property in Leigh, suspected of being involved in puppy trafficking. Cathy discovers two Jack Russell types and two Yorkshire Terriers. Tragically, they were too late one for one dog that had passed away and another has badly fractured leg. Will Cathy be able to provide the escape that these dogs desperately need?

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them. For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc. Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from "The Avengers"!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: A lone cow has gone wild and escaped into a neighbouring field.Dr. Matt has been called in to lend a hand. The heifer " went wild" two months ago and various tactics are employed to get Matt close enough to get a good shot with his dart gun. But the wary cow wins the first round and escapes. Matt decides to return another day.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Chief Inspector Cathy Hyde is on a warrant to access a property in Leigh, suspected of being involved in puppy trafficking. Cathy discovers two Jack Russell types and two Yorkshire Terriers. Tragically, they were too late one for one dog that had passed away and another has badly fractured leg. Will Cathy be able to provide the escape that these dogs desperately need?

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt pays his weekly visit to Flamingoland, near Malton in North Yorkshire, and is called to inspect a new arrival, a male Asian Sarus Crane brought in as company to a resident female. programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Birkenhead, Inspector Anthony Joynes is accompanied by the police to attend an unlocked and empty property. Inside he finds Teddy, the terrified Terrier cross that has a flea infestation so bad that he's missing half his fur. One-year-old Teddy is incredibly nervous, but will he be able to overcome his fears and allow the RSPCA to offer him help?

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Sugar gliders have bodies similar to that of a mustelid, and has a long, curly tail that cannot grab anything. Males are larger than females, measuring 25-30 cm long from nose to tail. Their fur is thick and soft, generally bluish-gray in color, but can also be yellow, tan, or white. The area from their nose to the middle of their back is black, while their abdomen, throat and chest are creamy white in color.

programme.title: My House And Other Animals
programme.desc: Meet the modern-day Dr Doolittles with a passion for all creatures great and small: the unsung heroes of the wildlife world, whose homes have become havens for every animal imaginable.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: Fishes swim in the water. What a healing thing it would be to be able to look at the blue ocean every day if we can own an underwater world at home! programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Early morning at the Brash household and Dr. Matt and his wife Clare, a horse vet, with their children enjoy a traditional English breakfast - on a traditional Dales day. In a rural community, vets are crucial. Matt started as a farm vet before specialising in exotic animals. The show also gives him an opportunity to keep in touch with livestock.

programme.title: Matahari Cerah Lagi (Ulangan)

programme.title: Ready, Set, Action!

programme.title: Pasikithu Lah!

programme.desc: Di setiap episod, Michael mengetengahkan kepada penonton hidangan halal yang berbeza dari inspirasi kepada penyediaan. Dari resepi barat, Cina, fusion dan sebagainya. programme.title: Border Towns of Sarawak
programme.desc: Documentary filmmaker Yusmal Ghazali explores borderlands, immersing in local life, meeting officials, villagers, entrepreneurs. Revealing history, traits, economy, tourism, post-pandemic challenges.

programme.title: (L) Berita Iban TVS
programme.desc: Berita Iban memaparkan berita-berita terkini di seluruh Malaysia dalam bahasa Iban

programme.title: (DL) Menarik Sepuluh
programme.desc: Menarik Sepuluh mengumpulkan 10 kisah unik dan menarik berlaku di mana sahaja

programme.title: (L) UTAMA 740
programme.desc: UTAMA 740 memaparkan berita terkini yang menyeluruh dan padat dari dalam dan luar negara.

programme.title: (DL) Detik Dunia
programme.desc: Detik Dunia membawakan rangkuman berita antarabangsa, mengetengahkan perkembangan global serta kisah-kisah yang membentuk landskap dunia hari ini.

programme.title: Gerak Khas 2.0
programme.desc: Pasukan elit polis menyiasat jenayah berprofil tinggi di Kuala Lumpur yang semakin berleluasa di Malaysia, di mana setiap kes bukan sahaja mencabar undang-undang, tetapi menguji kepercayaan, integriti.

programme.title: Boneka
programme.desc: Demi mengejar kehidupan sempurna, pengkhianatan seorang wanita terhadap suami yang pernah menyelamatkannya bermula apabila dia hanyut dalam godaan cinta dan kemewahan lelaki lain.

programme.title: (L) TVS Nightline
programme.desc: Memaparkan laporan peristiwa yang berlaku di seluruh Malaysia dalam bahasa English

programme.title: The Cube
programme.desc: The challenges appear to be simple - but games become fraught with extraordinary pressure and tension when played inside The Cube

programme.title: Anggun Mikayla
programme.desc: Born out of wedlock,a beautiful young lady,Mikayla works as a makeup artist who struggles to be acknowledged by her biological mom.She chose to embark on a new journey finding self-worth deserving love.

programme.title: Barbarossa
programme.desc: Sultan's Order historical drama about Barbaros Hayreddin,appointed as Captain by Sultan Suleyman the Magnificent,who turns the Mediterranean into a Turkish lake and founds the secret organization ITIMAT.

programme.title: Headgear Hunting
programme.desc: Dr Welyne Jehom, an anthropologist, search for expert traditional headgear makers in order to deepen her own knowledge of the craft and preserve the tradition for the benefit of future generations.

programme.title: Unearth Sarawak: Indigenous Cuisines
programme.desc: Showcases iconic and forgotten cuisines from Bidayuh, Melanau, Chinese, Iban, and Orang Ulu ethnics, aiming to preserve heritage cuisines, boost local communities, and promote gastronomy tourism.

programme.title: Pejalai Kamek Orang
programme.desc: Hosted and narrated by Tony Eusoff, traces locations and stories from people who have heard, experienced and witnessed events right from Brooke Era in 1841 leading up to Sarawak's independence in July 1968

programme.title: Ride Your Story
programme.desc: Docu-series to show case a different aspect of Borneo from the back of a bike, ridden by 5 biker chicks. There will be real encounters with bad weather, mechanical breakdowns and difficult terrains.

programme.title: The Food That Binds the Nation
programme.desc: Sebuah dokumentari kembara gastronomi yang merentas dari Perlis ke Sarawak, memperkenalkan keunikan juadah berbilang budaya yang memupuk perpaduan dalam kepelbagaian selera.

programme.title: Pewaris Legasi
programme.desc: Dalam kebimbangan minat remaja pada kerjaya kraftangan, pewaris gigih menjaga warisan ini. Rancangan ini memaparkan kerjaya kraftangan di Malaysia, menyeru penonton menghargai usaha mempertahankannya.

programme.title: Jelu Siga
programme.desc: Jelu Siga is a captivating nature series that unearths the hidden and often forgotten stories of endangered wildlife in the heart of Borneo.

programme.title: Journey of the Bidayuh
programme.desc: James Ritchie will take us to discover more about the Bidayuh. A documentary series that will touch on the aspects of Bidayuh culture, tradition, history and where this race fares in today's world.

programme.title: El Desprecio - S01:E76
programme.desc: Pastora preguntó a Israel si la ama a ella o a su gemela, ya que éste estuvo enamorado de Illis en el pasado; confundido, Israel se retira

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E025
programme.desc: Leopoldo advierte a Fernanda que, contrario a lo que ella piensa, Florencia pudiera estar siendo utilizada por Hilario en su contra. Victoria se conmueve al ver a Nicolás bajo la lluvia esperando que ella le dé una respuesta; Clementina insta a su amiga a no ceder todavía. Eugenia se molesta al leer la nota que le envió Yosmir con el libro que le regaló sugiriéndole que, cuando vuelva a ir a la cancha de bateo, lleve a su mamá con ella. Nicolás le deja un mensaje en el celular a Fernanda pidiéndole que no salga de su casa, pues no saben qué quiere la persona que la está amenazando y él no se perdonaría que le pase algo por no haberla detenido a tiempo en su plan.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E026
programme.desc: Victoria y Nicolás se besan enamorados; él le promete que siempre estará a su lado antes de sumergirse con ella en el mar en medio de un apasionado beso. Antonieta y Eugenia exigen a Leopoldo les diga qué está ocurriendo con Fernanda que no ha aparecido desde temprano. Hilario disfruta la velada con Florencia en un parque de diversiones donde la joven lo abraza y asegura saber que él la va a proteger siempre; mientas que, internamente, contiene la rabia que siente por el hombre. Hansen siente cierta decepción cuando Adelaida sugiere que lo quiere como un hermano y confía en que él no sería capaz de ocultarle algo que le hiciera daño. Carlos está a punto de confesarle su amor a la mujer, pero desiste cuando ella le habla de que su único sueño es que su amor por Hilario convierta su matrimonio en algo distinto a lo que es actualmente.

programme.title: Te Tengo en Salsa - S01:E03
programme.desc: Intentando descubrir si Carlos Raúl es el padre de Tatiana, Adriana indaga qué haría el hombre si una mujer le atribuye la paternidad de su bebé

programme.title: Te Tengo en Salsa - S01:E04
programme.desc: Después de escoger la torta que le hará Matilde, Beatrice revela a Adriana que Carlos Raúl tiene novia desde hace muchos años.

programme.title: Abigail - S04:E011 - Episode 11
programme.desc: Ninoska no entiende por qué Carlos Alfredo defiende a Cheíto ante la policía. Álvaro le confiesa su amor a Abigail. Mariana le exige a Abigail decirle la verdad sobre su enfermedad. María Begoña vestida de María Clara, pide a Carlota irse de la ciudad.

programme.title: Abigail - S04:E012 - Episode 12
programme.desc: Carlota le pide a Cheíto que se vayan de ahí, ya que la policía lo está buscando y él le dice que no se irá. En medio de la pelea, Carlota le confiesa que ella no es su madre. Carlota habla con Abigail y descubre que ella no fue quien le mandó el dinero

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E21
programme.desc: Alberto y Malena van a visitar a su padre, y ambos hermanos se encuentran a Marco Aurelio muerto en su cama, con un tiro en el corazón. Gertrudis, en excelente teatro, cae "desmayada". Lorena está en el hospital con su pequeño. Alberto descarta por completo la posibilidad de que Lorena sea la responsable del asesinato de su padre. Gertrudis siente que le estalla el corazón, al ver que Claudio es detenido por la policía.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E029 - Episodio 29

programme.desc: Al ver las fotos que hay del caso Corona en una cartelera, Lorena duda en confiarle a Omar lo que sabe. Pablo notifica que no le dará el divorcio. Paulina quiere que Gertrudis la acompañe a ver a la psíquica que hizo contacto con Marco Aurelio, pero su hermana la despacha molesta por creer en superticiones.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E27

programme.title: El Desprecio - S01:E81
programme.desc: Tamara arremete contra Clara acusándola de haber arruinado su vida al separarla de los dos hombres que ha amado.

programme.title: El Desprecio - S01:E82
programme.desc: En la mansión Santa María, Clara Inés ordena a los obreros que se lleven a Pastora lejos. Llega Raúl, quien demanda que dejen en paz a su madre.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E031
programme.desc: Victoria trata de hacerle entender a Hilario que ella y Nicolás se aman sin importarle los odios del pasado entre su familia. Isaura y Carmencita están decididas a buscar la manera de convencer a Adelaida de que el verdadero Hilario no es el que le escribe las cartas. Yosmir le hace creer a Isaura que está saliendo con la hija del dueño de la carnicería para conseguir que la señora le preste dinero. Victoria asegura a Nicolás que no volverá a creer en sus mentiras, pues ya leyó todos sus correos y descubrió su plan; él aunque no entiende de qué le habla, le ruega que no se deje engañar por Hilario y sigan adelante con su idea de casarse; ella decide quemar Los Samanes e insta a Nicolás a marcharse de Cantarrana en la avioneta que le tiene preparada, pues ella está decidida a matar el amor que siente por él para siempre. Adelaida admite ante Carmencita que debe reconocer que Hilario nunca va a dejar de hacerla sufrir, pero ella tampoco va a dejar de amarlo.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E032
programme.desc: Aunque Victoria quiere que Hilario se olvide de Nicolás de una vez; el señor Guanipa está seguro de que llegará el día en que ella misma le pedirá que le cobre a Del Casal lo que le hizo, pues no va a poder vivir con tanta rabia. Fernanda se molesta al saber que Nicolás estuvo en Cantarrana. Nicolás comenta con Florencia que está seguro de que Fernanda se las ingenió para mandar desde su computadora un montón de cartas que le hicieron creer a Victoria que él la ha estado engañando; el joven está convencido de que la joven Zapata no es quien está ayudando a su tía y duda que haya sido Hilario quien contratara a alguien que lo hiciera como ella sugiere. Nicolás le cuenta a Fernanda de los papeles que encontró en Los Samanes; el joven asevera que, aunque Victoria los destruyó, él recuerda varios nombres y piensa que con eso, y lo que Rosendo le contara a Florencia, pueden empezar a buscar pruebas en contra de Guanipa.

programme.title: Te Tengo en Salsa - S01:E09
programme.desc: Adriana se niega a creer que Carlos Raúl haya dejado a su novia; el médico le jura que no le miente en el momento que Azalea se acerca preguntando de qué habla la pareja.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E28
programme.desc: Pedro sugiere que aguarden el lapso acordado con Gertrudis, antes de tomar cualquier decisión respecto a la vida de la enfermera. Claudio intenta cercar a Lorena con el fin de que desaparezca de sus vidas, pero la joven lo encara dispuesta a todo. Omar recibirá un video donde revela paso a paso cómo y quiénes negociaron la muerte del Dr. Marco Aurelio Corona.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E29
programme.desc: Claudio busca intimidar a Lorena, seguro de que no existe tal video que los incrimine; ella se mantiene firme, pero no revela su contenido exacto. Lorena se sirve de la cámara de su teléfono portátil para grabar todo lo que sabe sobre la muerte de Marco Aurelio Corona.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E033
programme.desc: Nicolás afirma que desea vengarse de Hilario lo antes posible, pues ahora también tiene que cobrarle que lo apartara de la mujer que ama. Hilario quiere desaparecer a Nicolás, pero Victoria no quiere tragedias, sino arruinar al joven Del Casal y toda su familia. Adelaida relee las supuestas cartas de Hilario, pero las esconde cuando el hombre llega a su lado; la señora acepta las caricias de su esposo aunque se siente muy confundida por lo que acaba de descubrir. A Felipe le extraña cuando Hansen le ordena que prepare una carpeta con todos los negocios que tienen en Cantarrana, pues debe viajar de inmediato para la hacienda. programme.desc: Each episode of Oddly Satisfying Science will introduce us to several visually appealing experiments designed to blow our minds. programme.title: Dropped - S06:E04 - Driving the Bus
programme.desc: Chris and Casey are introduced to the tastes of the New Zealand wild, and get a rude awakening. Mother Nature's mind games start to mess with the brothers' mental strength, while their inflatable raft continues to be a serious problem.

programme.title: Wardens - S09:E09 - Buck Warrant and ORV Stickers
programme.desc: In Michigan, officers from District 7 handle cases involving people fishing without licenses and boats that aren't registered. Plus, a conservation officer in the Upper Peninsula looks into an off-road vehicle missing its required stickers.

programme.title: Wardens - S09:E10 - Michigan Elk
programme.desc: In District 3, Michigan conservation officers are looking into a case where a bull elk was shot using a tag meant for a cow. They're also checking out another elk that was taken on private land without the owner's okay.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E06 - Devious Defenses
programme.desc: Animals can employ a number of different defenses in order to withstand an attack. Some seek safety in herds, some hide in plain sight, some meet aggression with even stronger aggression, and some build fortresses. Whatever the strategy it is clear that animals will do whatever it takes to survive the wild.

programme.title: Wildlife Heroes - S01:E03 - Bear In Focus
programme.desc: A group of conservationists are observing a family of black bears in the wooded hills of Oklahoma, and Ivan gets to meet them.

programme.title: Wildlife Heroes - S01:E04 - Aggressive Measures

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai - S01:E01 - The Last Frontier
programme.desc: Join filmmaker Casey Anderson as he embeds in the Alaskan wilderness to follow the largest terrestrial carnivores in the world. Every fall in the northern Pacific, up to a million salmon migrate back to the rivers and streams where they were born to spawn. Many of these streams are located in Katmai National Park, Alaska. It’s here where a massive population of coastal brown bears gather to eat these fish.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai - S01:E02 - Fish Like A Bear
programme.desc: Join filmmaker Casey Anderson as he embeds in the Alaskan wilderness to follow the largest terrestrial carnivores in the world. The crew heads inland to a section of the river to observe the many different families as they fish. Along their path, they have an intimate encounter with a mom and her three cubs. They arrive at their destination and see many bears that they have already met as well as some new faces.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai - S01:E03 - A Working Ecosystem
programme.desc: Everyone hates biting insects, but if you look closer you can see that even the tiniest and most irritating bug can be essential for a working ecosystem. During a lull in bear and salmon activity, Casey and the crew decide to head inland in search of the spawning fish.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai - S01:E04 - The Wolf and the Storm
programme.desc: After seeing a wolf in the distance and tracks on the shore, the crew head inland in search of more clues to the wolf's whereabouts. They encounter a familiar bear family on their way and decide to follow them to a local fishing spot where a large number of bears have gathered.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E05 - Masters of Attack
programme.desc: Carnivores can't just pick their meals off trees. To survive, they have to use every trick they've got to catch food that's just as keen on staying alive as they are. If their prey hides, they have to find it. If it runs, they must chase it. They have to track it if it's hard to pin down and beat it if it fights back. The predator might use its strength for the final blow, but the real effort lies in the strategy.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E06 - Devious Defenses
programme.desc: Animals can employ a number of different defenses in order to withstand an attack. Some seek safety in herds, some hide in plain sight, some meet aggression with even stronger aggression, and some build fortresses. Whatever the strategy it is clear that animals will do whatever it takes to survive the wild.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E10 - Naturally Resilient
programme.desc: Today‘s journey in search of more miracles of nature brings us to the Masurian Lake District which is an impressive water world in north-eastern Poland. We will then trade in the cool Baltic region for tropical Caribbean. Here we will prove that it would be wrong to link the Cuban province of Guantanamo only with the famous American naval base. To wrap things up, we will return to Europe’s Mediterranean region to visit people of the Lipari Islands who continue to survive in the shade of ever-smouldering volcanoes.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E11 - Naturally Distinctive
programme.desc: In this episode we visit places where people haven’t had it easy. Despite the hardships they experience daily, they choose to stay and shape their destiny. Bamiyan – a poverty stricken Afghan province, mercilessly tested by time. Niğde – a Turkish province with striking history. And Patagonia – the rough land at the very end of the world.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E12 - Naturally Refreshing
programme.desc: Thailand is one of the few countries in south-east Asia that has never been a European colony. Perhaps the word "thai" which means "free" has something to do with it. It is possibly the reason why this country evokes a certain magic that sets it apart from the surrounding countries. From Thailand we travel to Sri Lanka.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E13 - The Best Of
programme.desc: Miracles of Nature has travelled to the four corners of the Earth - we look back over the astonishing range of destinations visited – each offering remarkable and stunning sights combined with dramatic histories and awe inspiring beauty.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai - S01:E03 - A Working Ecosystem
programme.desc: Everyone hates biting insects, but if you look closer you can see that even the tiniest and most irritating bug can be essential for a working ecosystem. During a lull in bear and salmon activity, Casey and the crew decide to head inland in search of the spawning fish.

programme.title: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai - S01:E04 - The Wolf and the Storm
programme.desc: After seeing a wolf in the distance and tracks on the shore, the crew head inland in search of more clues to the wolf's whereabouts. They encounter a familiar bear family on their way and decide to follow them to a local fishing spot where a large number of bears have gathered.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E05 - Masters of Attack
programme.desc: Carnivores can't just pick their meals off trees. To survive, they have to use every trick they've got to catch food that's just as keen on staying alive as they are. If their prey hides, they have to find it. If it runs, they must chase it. They have to track it if it's hard to pin down and beat it if it fights back. The predator might use its strength for the final blow, but the real effort lies in the strategy.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E06 - Devious Defenses
programme.desc: Animals can employ a number of different defenses in order to withstand an attack. Some seek safety in herds, some hide in plain sight, some meet aggression with even stronger aggression, and some build fortresses. Whatever the strategy it is clear that animals will do whatever it takes to survive the wild.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E10 - Naturally Resilient
programme.desc: Today‘s journey in search of more miracles of nature brings us to the Masurian Lake District which is an impressive water world in north-eastern Poland. We will then trade in the cool Baltic region for tropical Caribbean. Here we will prove that it would be wrong to link the Cuban province of Guantanamo only with the famous American naval base. To wrap things up, we will return to Europe’s Mediterranean region to visit people of the Lipari Islands who continue to survive in the shade of ever-smouldering volcanoes.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E11 - Naturally Distinctive
programme.desc: In this episode we visit places where people haven’t had it easy. Despite the hardships they experience daily, they choose to stay and shape their destiny. Bamiyan – a poverty stricken Afghan province, mercilessly tested by time. Niğde – a Turkish province with striking history. And Patagonia – the rough land at the very end of the world.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E12 - Naturally Refreshing
programme.desc: Thailand is one of the few countries in south-east Asia that has never been a European colony. Perhaps the word "thai" which means "free" has something to do with it. It is possibly the reason why this country evokes a certain magic that sets it apart from the surrounding countries. From Thailand we travel to Sri Lanka.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E13 - The Best Of
programme.desc: Miracles of Nature has travelled to the four corners of the Earth - we look back over the astonishing range of destinations visited – each offering remarkable and stunning sights combined with dramatic histories and awe inspiring beauty.

programme.title: Destination Mars - S01:E04 - Surviving on Mars

programme.title: Destination Mars - S01:E05 - Why One Way
programme.desc: Mars One plans one-way missions to Mars; the goal is not simply to explore, but to colonize the red planet. A one-way trip saves billions and eliminates the risk of a return voyage. But can the crew survive in such utter isolation? Some candidates for the mission reflect on this challenge.

Whether is big a footprint as Alf Ramsey, or as small as Paul the Octopus, it all happened on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E06 - 1966 World Cup, Eusébio, Portugal, Ronaldo, Mozambique, Primeira Liga

So many storylines - on football’s greatest stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E05 - Pelé, Stockholm, Sweden, Eisenhower, The Beatles, World Cup 1958
programme.desc: The story of Pelé taking the World Cup by the scruff of the neck at the age of 17 is legend. And we all know what we went on to do after that. It’s all in this installment of Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E04 - Gerd Muller, 2010 World Cup
programme.desc: A ultimate story of commitment, Gerd Müller was a footballer for the people. Marcello Lippi - tasked with lifting Italy’s fortunes, delivers the Azzurri a famous victory in 2006. programme.title: Football’s Greatest Stage
programme.desc: A World Cup hero for West Germany, Franz Beckenbauer is enshrined in his country’s football folklore. That’s this week, on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E01 - Platini, Pele

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E17 - Martina Navratilova, Novak Djokovic, Rod Laver
programme.desc: On this episode of Against the Odds, we salute the superstars of tennis, celebrating the off court bravery of Martina Navratilova, the relentless winning of Novak Djokovic, and the all round greatness of the man who ushered in the modern professional era, Rod Laver.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E36 - Eric Cantona, Marta, Shinji Kagawa
programme.desc: Eric Cantona battled his own demons and teammates to become one of the best football players of the 90s, Marta took on prejudice and unequal pay to win a better place for women in world football, and Shiji Kagawa scored his way from Japan’s second division to reach the glamour of Manchester United.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E33 - Nicola Adams, Refugee Olympic Team, and Abebe Bikila
programme.desc: Nicola Adams became the first woman to win Olympic boxing gold, and then the first woman to do it twice, the Refugee Olympic Team escaped war and social disintegration to fulfill their dream of competing at the Olympics, and Abebe Bikila shocked the world by winning marathon gold and breaking the world record in 1960 without shoes.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E35 - Amanda Nunes, Conor McGregor
programme.desc: Amanda Nunes beat every single women’s champion in her divisions’ history to become the greatest female fighter ever. Conor McGregor took over the world’s biggest fight promotion in only a few brief years before crossing over to boxing to face the greatest boxer of all time in the biggest fight in history.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E34 - Fanny Blankers-Koen, Carl Lewis, Mia Hamm, Babe Didrikson
programme.desc: Fanny Blankers Koen didn’t let war or children stop her from winning a record gold medal haul, Carl Lewis matched a fifty year old Olympic record and then surpassed it, Mia Hamm brought US soccer from a marginal curiosity to the front of the Olympic stage, and Babe Zaharias became the best at everything when she was expected to be nothing at all.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E28 - Tyson Fury, Randy Turpin, Claressa Shields
programme.desc: Tyson Fury defeated two of the scariest boxers in history and his own inner demons to become the heavyweight champion of the world - twice. Randy Turpin overcame the greatest boxer of all time at the height of his powers and Claressa Shields persevered through the most violent city in America to shough female boxers a new definition of success.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E29 - Magic Johnson, Becky Hammon, Yao Ming
programme.desc: Magic Johnson proved to everyone that HIV wasn’t a death sentence by flourishing in his post-playing career.
